cases.title: Unsupported adoption claim
cases.target_claim: Seventy percent of local retailers adopted AI inventory tools in 2025.

context.notes: No source or dataset was supplied.

cases.title: Compound claim with narrower evidence
cases.target_claim: The pilot increased conversion and reduced support costs across the company.

evidence.content: In the mobile pilot for new users, conversion rose from 4.0% to 4.8%. Support costs and other business units were not measured.

context.notes: The target generalizes beyond the measured metric and population.

evidence.content: Management forecasts revenue of USD 50 million for the year ending 31 December 2026.

cases.title: Causal and numeric overstatement
cases.target_claim: Training caused complaints to fall by 40%, from 50 cases to 35 cases.

evidence.content: Complaints were 50 in the month before training and 35 in the month after. No control group was used, and order volume fell during the second month.

cases.title: Old source and undefined current population
cases.target_claim: Most current platform users prefer email support.

evidence.content: A 2019 survey found 58% of 220 enterprise-plan respondents preferred email support. The platform and customer mix were substantially redesigned in 2024.

context.notes: No current-user definition or freshness threshold was supplied.
